items: It is an efficient diagnostic technique used for detecting genotypes of infectious agents.
It is used to detect genetic mutations responsible for certain genetic diseases and cancers.
In criminal investigations, “DNA fingerprints” are prepared from the cells in a tiny sample of dried blood or at the base of a single human hair.
Physicians can detect genetic defects in very early embryos by collecting a few sloughed-off cells and amplifying their DNA.
PCR is also used to examine the DNA of extinct species, as long as even a minuscule amount of their DNA remains intact.
